decisive_items: obstruction of the right hepatic bile duct
response.rationale: The imaging and cytology directly point to a biliary-origin mucin-producing neoplasm with papillary atypia, whereas lung adenocarcinoma metastasis is only a historical possibility with no supportive lesion-specific evidence.

rejected.why: No direct evidence links the hepatic mass to the prior lung adenocarcinoma; the biliary obstruction, mucin-producing tumor features, and papillary cytology favor a primary biliary neoplasm.
